check_version_published.description: Ask the Central Portal whether a version is already out. Maven Central never lets a published version be replaced, so this is the check to run before a release goes out: if the answer is yes, the version number has to go up. Answers immediately, without waiting for the search index to catch up. Reads only, and only about your own namespaces.

Reads only: it never releases or discards anything, and only reads your own deployments.

description: Read the Java and JVM package registry from a workflow. Search every library on Maven Central by name, namespace, packaging, tag or release date, get any library's current version and full version history, and read a release's POM for its licence, developers, source repository and dependencies. Find which artifact contains a given Java class, identify an unlabelled jar from its SHA-1, and get the direct download URL, size and checksums of any published file. It also watches your own releases on the Central Portal: whether a version number has already been used, how a deployment your build uploaded is progressing through validation, and what is inside one before it goes out. Every action reads: nothing here uploads, releases or discards anything on Maven Central.
